ED_Title: Participation of non-governmental organizations, civil society organizations, academic institutions and the private sector in the 2026 high-level meeting on HIV/AIDS
ED_DecisionText:
At its 89th plenary meeting, on 5 June 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of its President (Footnote: A/80/L.74.), as amended16 (Footnote: A/80/L.75.) recalling paragraph 13 of its resolution 80/256 of 24 April 2026, entitled “Organization of the 2026 high-level meeting on HIV/AIDS”, decided to approve the participation of the non-governmental organizations, civil society organizations, academic institutions and the private sector as listed in the annex to the present decision in the high-level meeting on HIV/AIDS, to be held pursuant to resolution 80/256.
